About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI platform that drives business transformation and unlocks new value for enterprises. Our multi-agent platform assesses complex business systems, designs their future state and executes change with greater speed, consistency and control.

We combine enterprise systems expertise with product engineering to address fragmented data, custom development, interconnected processes and years of accumulated business decisions.

Our architects shape both customer outcomes and the platform itself. Their expertise becomes reusable capabilities, so each engagement benefits from the lessons of the last.

The Opportunity

As our SAP Enterprise Asset Management Architect, you will shape how customers transform maintenance and asset management, with a particular focus on ECC-to-S/4HANA programs.

You will own EAM architecture across technical objects, maintenance strategies, work identification, planning, scheduling, execution and reporting, with integration to procurement, spare-parts inventory, production, finance and mobile maintenance.

Much of this work starts with maintenance estates built up over many years: inconsistent equipment hierarchies, preventive plans that no longer reflect asset needs, spreadsheet scheduling, custom work-order processes, unreliable failure data and disconnected mobile tools. You will lead customers in distinguishing essential operating requirements from historical workarounds and establish a design their maintenance and operations teams can trust.

Working directly with product and engineering teams, you will turn field experience into better assessments, stronger asset-data checks and reusable platform capabilities. Success means a defensible architecture, reliable maintenance planning and execution, trustworthy asset information and sustained adoption, delivered with customer maintenance and operations leaders and Tessera’s delivery teams.

What You Will Own

EAM Architecture and Design

  • Own EAM solution design, architectural recommendations and domain acceptance criteria, aligned with the Principal Solution Architect’s overall solution accountability.

  • Lead decisions across maintenance organizational structures, planning and maintenance plants, planner groups and work centers.

  • Define technical-object architecture across functional locations, equipment hierarchies, classifications, asset BOMs, measuring points and counters.

  • Design the maintenance lifecycle from notification and prioritization through planning, scheduling, execution, confirmation, technical completion and settlement, including time- and usage-based strategies, maintenance plans and task lists.

  • Guide labor and capacity planning, material availability, external services, refurbishment and repairable spares where relevant.

  • Define reporting for backlog, schedule compliance, preventive maintenance compliance, maintenance cost and asset reliability.

  • Guide configuration and development teams, review functional specifications and document architectural decisions.

ECC-to-S/4HANA Transformation

  • Lead discovery across ECC Plant Maintenance configuration, custom development, interfaces, technical-object data, maintenance plans and open work.

  • Recommend the EAM implications of system conversion, selective data transition or new implementation, and translate simplification items and readiness findings into scope, dependencies and remediation plans.

  • Evaluate S/4HANA Asset Management processes, Fiori applications and operating models against customer requirements and the target release and deployment model.

  • Assess the future mobile maintenance landscape and the role of SAP Asset Performance Management or other reliability and condition-monitoring solutions.

  • Define migration and reconciliation requirements for technical objects, classifications, BOMs, task lists, maintenance plans, measurement history and open notifications and orders, preserving historical access and traceability.

Controlled Delivery and Adoption

  • Define integrated tests covering corrective work, maintenance-plan calls, scheduling parameters, counter readings, parts and services procurement, execution, confirmations and settlement.

  • Lead EAM cutover readiness across open orders, outstanding maintenance calls, material reservations, measurement readings and mobile synchronization, with controls that prevent missed or duplicate scheduled work.

  • Partner with maintenance, operations and EHS specialists to translate approved work-clearance, permit and isolation requirements into system controls.

  • Partner with finance on maintenance cost collection, budgeting, settlement and the link between technical objects and fixed assets.

  • Apply fit-to-standard and clean-core principles with technical architects.

  • Work with customer leaders to establish ownership of asset master data, maintenance strategies and failure-data standards.

  • Drive adoption through practical knowledge transfer and resolution of the issues that prevent planners, supervisors, technicians and reliability engineers from trusting the new processes.

Platform and Product Development

  • Work with Tessera’s AI agents and engineers while retaining accountable architectural judgment.

  • Define validation checks, exception criteria and human review points for AI-assisted asset-data and maintenance work.

  • Turn recurring customer challenges into reusable rules, design patterns and controls, and validate platform outputs against customer evidence.

  • Support pre-sales with realistic assessments of scope, effort, dependencies and risk.

How You Will Work

You will lead EAM architecture across concurrent engagements, with involvement varying by project stage. You will work with Technical Program Managers on priorities, dependencies and capacity, and with configuration, development and delivery teams on implementation.

Your core expertise should be in SAP Plant Maintenance and S/4HANA Asset Management, and you should be comfortable working with maintenance and operations teams at site level. You will set boundaries with P2P for purchasing and external services, inventory and warehouse teams for spares, Plan-to-Produce for maintenance windows and R2R for accounting and fixed assets, and involve reliability, safety or industry specialists where needed.

We value hands-on investigation, clear recommendations and early escalation of risks and competing milestones, particularly around maintenance continuity and operational readiness.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of SAP Plant Maintenance and enterprise asset management experience, including architectural leadership across complex transformations.

  • At least one completed S/4HANA Asset Management implementation or conversion, including go-live and stabilization.

  • Deep hands-on expertise in technical objects, notifications, maintenance orders, maintenance plans and strategies, task lists, measuring points, counters and confirmations.

  • Strong understanding of maintenance planning, scheduling, backlog management, labor capacity and material readiness, across corrective and preventive maintenance.

  • Strong command of MRO spare parts and external services, and of maintenance cost settlement with Controlling and Asset Accounting.

  • Practical experience with ECC-to-S/4HANA readiness, asset-data migration, open-work reconciliation and cutover.

  • Experience making fit-to-standard decisions and evaluating extensions with technical architects.

  • The ability to communicate architectural trade-offs to maintenance leaders, plant managers, reliability engineers, finance teams and developers.

  • Evidence of sustained adoption, effective knowledge transfer and sound delivery across concurrent engagements.

  • Strong business English and effective collaboration across distributed teams.

  • The ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and assess its outputs critically. Within your first months, you will independently use Tessera’s platform to lead EAM assessments and contribute reusable improvements.

  • A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Experience We Value

Depth in one or more of the following is welcome:

  • SAP Asset Performance Management, reliability-centered maintenance and condition monitoring.

  • SAP Service and Asset Manager or other mobile maintenance solutions, including offline execution.

  • Shutdowns, turnarounds and outage planning.

  • Work Clearance Management and operational safety integration.

  • Refurbishment, repairable spares and serialized-component tracking.

  • Asset-intensive industries such as utilities, energy, chemicals, mining, manufacturing or transportation.

  • S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and Public Edition.

  • SAP Activate, SAP certifications or maintenance and reliability qualifications

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Build working fluency in Tessera’s platform, understand your customer portfolio and establish EAM priorities, risks and decision ownership.

By 90 days: Lead assigned engagements with documented recommendations, agreed priorities and clear asset-data, migration and acceptance criteria. Feed field insights into platform improvements.

First year: Customer-validated milestones, reliable maintenance scheduling and execution where programs reach production, trustworthy technical-object data, sustained adoption and reusable platform capabilities used across engagements, measured against customer-agreed baselines for backlog, schedule compliance, preventive maintenance compliance and maintenance cost.

Why Join Tessera

  • Own consequential asset-management architecture decisions with access to customer business and technology leaders.

  • Influence a product as well as individual implementations.

  • Work with engineers building AI-assisted enterprise transformation capabilities.

  • Turn hard-earned SAP experience into improvements that benefit multiple customers.

  • Help build the practices and standards of a growing Center of Excellence.

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.
